verdict.rationale: Highnote is API-first, so headless automation comes from its own capabilities: a GraphQL API covering the full payment lifecycle, an official Node.js SDK (beta), and a test environment that simulates authorizations and refunds and could support automated test runs. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines directly. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples, a CLI or headless tooling for pipelines, a non-beta SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The full payment lifecycle is available via API.
the official `@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk` (currently in beta) wraps the Highnote API in typed, resource-oriented methods — no GraphQL required.
One key, one endpoint, and a test environment that behaves like production. Simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements before you talk to anyone.
Issue cards per agent, workflow, or vendor via API. Each card closes automatically when the workflow ends. No manual provisioning.
